title: CloudDash pricing plans comparison
content:
## CloudDash plans

| Feature | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|---------|---------|-----|------------|
| Price | $29/month | $99/month | Custom (contact sales) |
| Cloud accounts | 1 | 5 | Unlimited |
| Team members | 3 | 15 | Unlimited |
| Dashboards | 5 | 50 | Unlimited |
| Alert rules | 10 | 100 | Unlimited |
| Metrics retention | 30 days | 13 months | Custom |
| Support | Email | Email + chat | Dedicated + SLA |
| SSO / SAML | No | Yes | Yes |
| SCIM provisioning | No | No | Yes |
| Audit logs | No | 30 days | 1 year |
| Custom integrations | No | No | Yes |

## Billing cycle
- All plans are billed **monthly** by default.
- Annual billing is available with a **20% discount**: Starter $278/year, Pro $950/year.
- Enterprise is invoiced annually with custom terms.

## Overages
- Starter/Pro plans do not allow overages — you must upgrade to access more resources.
- Enterprise plans can negotiate overage rates contractually.

## Taxes
Prices shown are exclusive of applicable taxes. Tax is calculated at checkout based on your billing address.

## Free trial
- All plans include a **14-day free trial** with no credit card required.
- Trial accounts have Pro-level features during the trial period.
